title: Prep Notes, Week 7
dek: Zach Charbonnet is out, so Emanuel Wilson is RB30 for me; Puka Nacua and Lamar Jackson are game-time calls.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Sat 7:30 PM ET: Lamar Jackson was downgraded to out, so Tyler Huntley starts again and Bo Nix is the pivot at QB15. Jordan Mason was activated off IR and plays at RB28. Philadelphia's report is in: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks are out, Dallas Goedert practiced in full with no designation at TE9, and Saquon Barkley is questionable after a full Saturday practice, RB29. George Pickens has no designation for Dallas.

Friday's final reports are in for Week 7. Seven fantasy players are out, nobody we play is doubtful, and seven are questionable. Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery and Zach Charbonnet are out, so Tyler Allgeier is RB27 for me, Woody Marks is RB16 and an RB2, and Emanuel Wilson is RB30. Rashee Rice, Mike Evans, Emeka Egbuka and Tyler Warren are out too. Rankings are for full PPR.

The true Sunday decisions are Lamar Jackson, Puka Nacua, Breece Hall and Jordan Mason, who still needs his activation off IR by Saturday. Baker Mayfield is questionable but starts for Tampa Bay. Cleared with no designation: Josh Jacobs, Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Matthew Golden, Justin Jefferson, T.J. Hockenson, Travis Kelce, Bucky Irving, Alvin Kamara, Brock Bowers and Quinshon Judkins. Dallas and Philadelphia post their reports Saturday for Monday night, with Saquon Barkley and George Pickens the names to check.
outro_md: Order Up has the inactives Sunday morning, starting with Paris at 8:00 AM ET.

report.read: He has not practiced this week and misses a second straight game. Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80 with most of the red-zone work in Week 6, and Tyler Allgeier handles the passing downs.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Tyler Allgeier, RB27 for me vs DEN, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.

report.read: No practice all week, and Houston has its bye in Week 8. Woody Marks played 78 percent of the snaps at JAX and every snap inside the 5.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Woody Marks, RB16 for me vs NYG this week, an RB2.

report.read: A second straight game out. Keenan Allen drew 11 targets the last time Warren sat, and he is WR32 for me, a low-end WR3.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Kyle Pitts Sr., TE12 for me vs SF, a borderline start this week.

report.read: No practice all week; Kansas City is also without both starting tackles. Xavier Worthy is the top outside receiver left.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Xavier Worthy, WR30 for me at SEA, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.

report.read: Seattle activated him off PUP Thursday, then Mike Macdonald ruled him out Friday with no setback, to give the knee one more week. Emanuel Wilson played 46 snaps in Week 6, and George Holani takes the passing downs.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Emanuel Wilson, RB30 for me vs KC, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.

report.read: Out at ATL, then San Francisco has its bye, so Week 9 is the earliest return. Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle drew 18 combined targets Monday.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Brandin Cooks, WR45 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw; play a Tier 4 receiver over him if you have one.

report.read: Back on the field Friday but still in the concussion protocol. Baker Mayfield returns, and Chris Godwin Jr. practiced in full Friday.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Chris Godwin Jr., WR43 for me at CAR, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

report.read: Limited all week with the high ankle sprain, and Baltimore downgraded him to out Saturday, his third straight missed game. Tyler Huntley makes a third straight start vs CIN.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Bo Nix, QB15 for me at ARI, a streamer.

report.read: He missed all three practices this week with the hamstring, his third missed game this season. Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) is out too, so rookie Makai Lemon starts Monday vs DAL.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Germie Bernard, WR21 for me at NO, a WR2.

report.read: DeMeco Ryans expects him to play vs NYG in his first game since December 2024. He plays the slot, so Jaylin Noel loses routes first; Noel ran 63 percent of the routes in Week 6.
report.verdict: Outside my top 50 receivers in his first game back; sit him and watch his route share Sunday.

report.read: He left Thursday's practice early and did not practice Friday. Sean McVay said he lacked his full power, and tests showed a minor injury. Davante Adams is already out, so Konata Mumpfield and Tyler Higbee take the targets if he sits.
report.verdict: WR3 for me if he plays. Monitor the Rams' inactives at 2:55 PM ET and have a 4:25 PM backup ready.
report.watch: Rams inactives at 2:55 PM ET Sunday

report.read: Two limited practices after three missed games, and Aaron Glenn will take the decision to Sunday. Braelon Allen played 87 percent of the snaps in Week 6.
report.verdict: If Hall is out, Braelon Allen is RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2. If Hall plays, Allen drops to the flex range. Monitor the Jets' inactives at 11:30 AM ET.
report.watch: Jets inactives at 11:30 AM ET Sunday

report.read: Limited Wednesday and Thursday; Pittsburgh did not practice Friday before Paris, so Friday is an estimate. He had 7 carries to Jaylen Warren's 14 at TB.
report.verdict: RB31 for me if he plays, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play; sit him for any Tier 3 back.

report.read: Todd Bowles says he starts at CAR after three missed games, wearing a glove with a plate in it. Emeka Egbuka is out.
report.verdict: QB21 for me, a streamer at best; sit him for any top-12 quarterback.

report.read: Limited Thursday and Friday, then a full practice Saturday after missing two games. Dameon Pierce took 61 of 64 snaps vs CAR and goes back to the No. 2 share.
report.verdict: RB29 for me if he plays, a high-end RB3. Monitor the Eagles' inactives at 6:45 PM ET Monday and keep Pierce as the handcuff.
report.watch: Eagles inactives at 6:45 PM ET Monday
